[USER] The user expressed interest in the Strawberry Coffee Crisp recipe.  
[USER] The user requested advice on how to store fresh strawberries to keep them fresh for a longer period.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided tips for storing fresh strawberries:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Store in a cool, dry place away from sunlight.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Do not wash before storing; rinse just before use.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Remove stems and leaves to prevent moisture absorption.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Use a breathable container for storage.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Keep strawberries dry with a paper towel at the bottom of the container.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Store in a single layer to prevent moisture spread.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Use within 3 to 5 days at room temperature or up to 7 days refrigerated.  
[USER] The user found the storage tips helpful and requested the recipe for the Strawberry Coffee Crisp.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] The assistant provided the detailed recipe for Strawberry Coffee Crisp, including ingredients and instructions:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Ingredients: 2 cups fresh strawberries, 2 tablespoons granulated sugar, 2 tablespoons cornstarch, 2 tablespoons coffee syrup, 1 tablespoon lemon juice, 1/4 teaspoon salt, 1/2 cup rolled oats, 1/2 cup brown sugar, 1/2 cup chopped pecans (optional), 1/4 cup cold unsalted butter, 1 teaspoon cinnamon.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C), prepare strawberry mixture, prepare oat topping, assemble the crisp, bake for 40-45 minutes, serve warm.
